heading: Who Am I? Where I have contributed so far?
description: Frontend Engineer with 10+ years of experience leading teams, building projects from scratch to production, and delivering optimized, scalable solutions. Experienced in technical architecture, UI/UX strategy, and modern web technologies including React JS, Vue JS, Node JS, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, and CSS. Proven track record of direct customer engagement, requirement analysis, and live project management. Recognized multiple times for outstanding contributions and excellence in client delivery.

organizations.professionalSummary: Strategic technical leader specializing in scalable, high-performance frontend architectures for the global travel industry. Expert in React and headless Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) integrations, delivering multi-tenant platforms for global partners such as Air New Zealand and Wyndham. Proven ability to design reusable component libraries that accelerate delivery, ensure consistency, and support complex international booking experiences. Core Responsibilities & Achievements: **Architectural Leadership:** Spearheaded the design and development of a scalable React frontend integrated with Java Spring Boot microservices using a headless AEM architecture. **Modular Component Design:** Engineered a reusable React component library leveraging AEM SPA Mapping, enabling rapid configuration and deployment across multiple global partners. **Global Partner Onboarding:** Orchestrated technical onboarding for high-profile clients including Frontier and Air New Zealand, supporting custom tour plans and holiday packages via an API-as-a-Service model. **Complex Checkout Orchestration:** Led end-to-end development of a five-stage reservation funnel, integrating PayPal, credit card, and offline payment gateways. **AEM-Driven Business Logic:** Built a seamless bridge between AEM configurations and React business logic, empowering non-technical teams to manage offers and promotions globally without code changes. **Build & Dependency Management:** Optimized multi-tenant CI/CD workflows using Maven and NPM to maintain high code quality and deployment efficiency. **Revenue Systems Integration:** Integrated commission-based backend logic into frontend booking flows, ensuring accurate transactions for global holiday and tour services. **Technical Stack & Tools** Frontend: React.js, React-AEM-SPA Mapping, JavaScript (ES6+), NPM Backend & CMS: Java Spring Boot (Microservices), Adobe Experience Manager Tools & Integration: Maven, Git, RESTful API

Working as a web application developer, transforming legacy applications into next-generation applications using cutting-edge technologies. Using UI Builder, a drag-and-drop development tool that allows developers to build UI components visually as well as write Oracle JET code for custom functionality. Ensuring UI components adhere to Oracle design standards, guidelines, and color schemes. Working with an MVC (Model-View-Controller) architecture and using Visual Builder within VS Code to develop UI components and implement business functionalities. Developing UI functionality and business logic primarily in the controller layer using JavaScript and Knockout.js. Collaborating within an Agile environment, following Scrum practices with sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and sprint tracking managed by Scrum Masters. Performing Selenium-based automation testing using Selenium Builder and Eclipse IDE for page component validation, functional testing, and quality assurance

Working as a Senior System Engineer in the Banking and Financial Services domain, with responsibilities including application development, unit testing, code reviews, and adherence to Agile development practices. Developing modern frontend applications using React.js, a client-developed React-compatible UI library, Jest-Cucumber with Enzyme for unit testing, and SonarLint to ensure code quality and best practices. Actively participating in code reviews, focusing on maintainability, reduced cognitive complexity, adherence to ES6+ standards, extensive use of arrow functions, code optimization, and modern JavaScript patterns to deliver scalable and efficient solutions. Leveraging AI-powered development tools such as GitHub Copilot to accelerate development workflows, generate test cases, scaffold components, and improve overall developer productivity. Contributed as a Lead UI Developer for a proprietary CRM platform and other enterprise-grade applications, delivering high-quality user interfaces and collaborating closely with cross-functional teams. Gained extensive experience working on complex enterprise projects, continuously enhancing technical expertise while contributing to innovative and impactful solutions
